charge.action: A continuous rightward cavalry charge shown in place, one complete eight-pose transverse gallop cycle of the same chestnut horse carrying the same armored knight. The horse truly articulates all four legs; hind propulsion, flight with gathered legs, foreleg reach, foreleg landing and load, hind leg recovery, a second brief suspension, then hind contact must be legible. Spread the successive gallop phases evenly across all eight drawings, with no duplicate first/last pose. Keep near and far legs distinguishable, physically credible knees and hocks, and a consistent horse barrel, head, rider, saddle and equipment size. The rider leans forward with a couched lance and follows the saddle's small rise and fall; seat, stirrups, reins and hand grips stay connected. The lance remains directed right and the shield stays attached. In flight all hooves lift from the shared ground plane; during stance the contacting hoof moves left relative to the in-place torso. Preserve the identity reference's camera, style, pixel density, proportions and colors exactly. One connected horse-and-rider per frame, eight separate non-touching subjects total, no motion trails, dust, scenery or shadows.

style: Follow the attached horse-and-rider reference exactly: identity, proportions, pixel block density, palette, outlines and materials.
